name: SaylivoChat
author: saylivochat

sections.description:
SaylivoChat is a live support panel for websites, online stores and social media profiles. This plugin adds the SaylivoChat chat widget to your WordPress or WooCommerce site without editing theme files.

  • One field: paste your site ID or the embed code from your SaylivoChat panel
  • Optional: prefill the chat form with the logged-in member’s username and display name
  • The widget loads asynchronously and does not slow down your pages

SaylivoChat panel features include multiple agents, automatic chat assignment, canned responses, an assistant trained on your own questions, offline messages with email notifications, reports, and Instagram, WhatsApp and Telegram channels.

Türkçe: SaylivoChat, sitenize kod düzenlemeden canlı destek penceresi ekler. Panelden aldığınız bağlantı kodunu Ayarlar → SaylivoChat sayfasına yapıştırmanız yeterli.

External services

This plugin connects to the SaylivoChat live chat service, which is required for the chat widget to work.

  • What is loaded: when a visitor opens any page of your site, the chat widget script is loaded from https://saylivochat.com/embed.js. Your site ID is sent with this request so the correct widget settings are shown.
  • What is sent: when a visitor starts a chat, the name, username and messages they enter are sent to SaylivoChat servers and are visible only in your own company’s panel. If the “Identify members” option is enabled, the logged-in member’s username and display name are also sent to prefill the chat form.

The service is provided by SaylivoChat.

  • Service: https://saylivochat.com
  • Terms of Use: https://saylivochat.com/kullanim-sartlari
  • Privacy Policy: https://saylivochat.com/gizlilik
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Settings → SaylivoChat.
  3. In your SaylivoChat panel, go to Settings → Sites → Embed code, copy the code and paste it into the plugin settings, then save.

No account yet? Start a free 7-day trial at https://saylivochat.com/kayit
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes. The plugin is free. The SaylivoChat service has a free 7-day trial and paid monthly plans after that.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The widget script is loaded asynchronously after your page content.

Where do I find my site ID?

In your SaylivoChat panel under Settings → Sites → Embed code. You can paste the whole code; the plugin extracts the ID automatically.
